\noindent\textbf{Participant Study ID:}\hfill\underline{\hspace{6cm}}

\vspace{0.25cm}

Please read each statement carefully. Tick each box to show that you agree.

\section*{1. Understanding the Programme}

$\square$ I confirm that I have read and understood the Participant Information Sheet.

$\square$ I have had the opportunity to ask questions and have received satisfactory answers.

$\square$ I understand that this is a structured weight-loss programme designed to help improve blood sugar control and possibly achieve remission of Type 2 Diabetes.

$\square$ I understand what the programme involves, including:

- A 12-week total diet replacement phase
- Gradual food reintroduction
- Ongoing weight-maintenance support
- Regular clinical monitoring

$\square$ I understand that participation is voluntary.

\section*{2. Voluntary Participation}

$\square$ I understand that I am free to withdraw from the programme at any time without giving a reason.

$\square$ I understand that withdrawing will not affect my usual diabetes care or relationship with health services.

\section*{3. Clinical Monitoring and Safety}

$\square$ I understand that my weight, blood pressure, HbA1c, and other routine clinical measurements will be recorded during the programme.

$\square$ I understand that my diabetes and blood pressure medications may be reduced, stopped, or restarted under clinical supervision to ensure safety.

$\square$ I understand that there may be side effects (for example dizziness, constipation, or low blood sugar), and that I should report any concerns to the clinical team.

\newpage
\section*{4. Use of My Data}

$\square$ I agree for my clinical information collected during the programme to be recorded in the TMR database.

$\square$ I agree for relevant information to be accessed from the St Helena Diabetes Registry for evaluation purposes.

$\square$ I understand that my data will be stored securely and handled in line with UK GDPR and local data protection requirements.

$\square$ I understand that my name will not appear in any reports or publications.

\section*{5. Service Evaluation and Future Use of Data}

$\square$ I agree for my anonymised data to be used to evaluate the TMR pilot programme.

$\square$ I agree that my anonymised data may be used in future research or service evaluations related to diabetes care.

$\square$ I understand that no information that identifies me personally will be shared outside the clinical team.

\section*{6. Questionnaires and Interviews (Optional)}

$\square$ I agree to complete questionnaires about my health, wellbeing, and experience of the programme.

$\square$ I agree to be contacted about taking part in an interview about my experience.

$\square$ I understand that taking part in interviews is optional and separate from the clinical programme.

\vspace{0.65cm}

\section*{7. Final Confirmation}
